06 — MULTIPLAYER, LIFECYCLE & UI: LOD-EVENT-EXPANSION and event lifecycle rules; LOD-CLASS-MILESTONES-UI-001

scope.jane: Subordinate Chuck companion; not a separate primary boss
scope.bribe_blockade: Explicitly removed; cannot appear in production or developer preview
scope.october23_changes: Remain deferred by current user instruction; do not activate or report missing as defects

fixture_setup: Use exact installed/mounted source on gm_flatgrass, an admin, a disposable Hero/test-data profile and an explicitly unranked developer session. M3 debug modules require developer mode at startup.
Preserve production settings for ordinary acceptance. Event previews regenerate one selected identity and print locators; they use real server-local wallets/items/DFTs and do not mint setup funds.
Walk from legitimate deployment to an event when claiming route acceptance. Console teleport/testkit relocation only accelerates mechanic fixtures and cannot count as traversal proof.

Use lod_equipment_economy_testkit or lod_equipment_catalog_testkit once for explicit resource fixtures; lod_chest_key_testkit supplies one finite key. No free-currency fixture is authorized by these event commands.

Alternate success/failure branches for once-only account claims require a fresh disposable campaign/dungeon entitlement; same-dungeon regeneration/reconnect is a repeat-rejection test, not a fresh attempt.
common_event_gates: Living deployed cooperative Hero, current exact body/account/run/graph/event binding, live clock, range/LOS and resource/capacity admission; Soldier/dead/staged/stale interactions reject.
For services: first Use reviews exact offer, second confirms within12s. Changed inventory/body/price refreshes rather than consumes; protected/starting/DFT gear cannot be salvage/reforge inputs.
A valid committed transaction has one debit/reward/receipt; rapid repeated Use, reconnect and same-dungeon regeneration cannot duplicate it. Failed admission or storage does not consume resources.

Try cancellation/abandonment and one regeneration while active per distinct lifecycle family. Sessions, native parts, owned statuses/hazards and control locks retire without affecting a later dungeon.

Population separately: lod_event_population_preview <positive_levelSeed> uses ordinary exact1d4; counts1–3 commons, count4 three commons+one rare among treasure_chest/contraband_lot/life_underwriter. No Bribe, duplicates, silent drops or event-count rerolls. Member/endpoints count once.
Verify shared versus personal state, simultaneous claims, late join, disconnect/reconnect on two real clients before cooperative acceptance; single-client fixtures cannot pass those rows.

events.scenario: Read stake/odds before Use; one account wager; retry after insufficient funds, repeat/reconnect rejection; observe both outcomes on separate entitlements.
events.expected: 5 $DEB stake; ordinary d4=4 pays 15 gross, otherwise zero. Other accounts retain their own play.

events.scenario: All classes use a Chest Key; Rogue also tries sprint+Use, including while carrying a key. Test failed pick then later key, full inventory and repeat Use.
events.expected: One frozen ordinary wearable/account/dungeon; failed pick uses no key; invalid capacity consumes neither key nor attempt.

events.scenario: Open each generated member by key or Rogue pick; cover both member counts and full DFT collection; retry/reconnect after claim.
events.expected: One or two members count as one rare identity; one frozen DFT/account/member; ordinary bag capacity is irrelevant.

events.scenario: Inspect price; buy below potion-stack capacity; retry at full stack/insufficient funds and after consuming purchased potion.
events.expected: 10 $DEB buys one ordinary Healing Potion, once/account/dungeon; denial costs nothing; use of potion does not renew purchase.

events.scenario: Walk around rim, then cross centered grounded footprint; observe native fall and ordinary return route. Occupy aperture before rearm; repeat after clearing.
events.expected: Optional one-floor physical drop; unsafe landing leaves lid solid; reclosure waits for clear aperture, with no forced teleport or progression bypass.

events.scenario: Approach both floor endpoints; test dormant-to-linked E traversal and repeat traversal; occupy arrival and retry; verify gates still govern access.
events.expected: Free paired shortcut, safe arrival or no move; first successful traversal links pair for party. Ordinary production starts at Dungeon5; explicit preview may bypass threshold.

events.scenario: Approach with future locks shut; fight real hostile; inspect barrier, XP/drop and navigation update; retry after respawn.
events.expected: Only exact canonical lethal defeat opens route once for everyone; no hidden resource prerequisite; removal alone is never victory.

events.scenario: Cover no eligible gear; decline before acceptance; correct answer, wrong answer and accepted cancellation/timeout on separate entitlements; inspect page/input restoration.
events.expected: Three readable equally styled cards; correct earns one DFT, incorrect steals exact selected eligible worn item; forfeiture steals nothing and mints nothing.

events.scenario: Use once to review, again within review window to confirm while hurt; try full health; observe existing ailment afterward.
events.expected: 12 $DEB restores missing HP but does not cure ailments; full health has no charge.

events.scenario: Review/confirm while Magic missing; test low HP and full Magic denials.
events.expected: 10 HP for up to25 Magic; never lethal; invalid admission spends nothing.

events.scenario: Carry spare eligible wearable, review exact item/value, change inventory before confirming, then review afresh; test protected/equipped items.
events.expected: Only reviewed eligible unequipped wearable is destroyed for canonical value; changed offer refreshes and consumes nothing.

events.scenario: Offer two spare eligible wearables; inspect exact fusion before confirmation; change one input; test capacity/result rejection.
events.expected: Canonical fusion of reviewed inputs; no starter/protected/DFT gear; failed result/admission preserves both inputs.

events.scenario: Review/confirm with potion and Magic; test missing resource and full Chest Key stack.
events.expected: One Healing Potion plus20 Magic becomes one Chest Key; denied conversion consumes neither input.

events.scenario: Hold eligible firearm with room in reserves; review then switch weapon; review again and confirm; try full ammo or crowbar.
events.expected: 15 Magic purchases one canonical large ration for held eligible firearm; wrong/full weapon spends nothing.

events.scenario: Inspect displayed wearable, review/confirm with potion; test missing potion/full bag; observe living unarmed NPC presentation.
events.expected: One potion trades for exactly displayed wearable; failed capacity retains potion; one personal receipt.

events.scenario: Review explicit friendly-fire risk while Magic missing; confirm; try again during Reckless and at full Magic.
events.expected: Full Magic in exchange for30s Reckless, using canonical status; denied/repeated transaction creates no extra grant.

events.scenario: Observe reviewed price over market time and same-dungeon regeneration; change quote before confirming; test full bag. Two-client competition remains separate.
events.expected: One exact shared wearable goes to first successful buyer; price follows monotonic market clock and floor; Hourglass/time allowance does not reset it.

events.scenario: Review/confirm with a reserve life; inspect life/debit/credit receipt; try with final life only.
events.expected: One reserve life buys40 $DEB; final life cannot be surrendered.

events.scenario: Observe safe/warning/active cycle; avoid, then risk active contact; disable with Use; observe status expiry and safe ordinary route.
events.expected: Canonical WIS save vs Muted; warning readable, existing status not extended; party disable persists until teardown.

events.scenario: Crouch past, then stand within field; inspect save/status; disable with Use.
events.expected: Canonical DEX save vs Clumsy; crouching avoids field; shared disable and cleanup.

events.scenario: Compare facing/averted gaze; attempt front Use then circle behind and unplug.
events.expected: Canonical WIS save vs Reckless only under gaze/range conditions; rear unplug disables for party.

events.scenario: Ask before and after objective/gate changes; compare reported floor/first steps with ordinary legal route; inspect unarmed NPC.
events.expected: Repeatable current legal objective guidance; closed gate/event is reported rather than inventing a route.

events.scenario: Solo lever: start, interrupt movement/cancel, retry and hold through unlock; collect then repeat. Add two-real-client plate branch later.
events.expected: Solo10s or two distinct Heroes on plates3s opens shared cache; each account claims15 $DEB once.

events.scenario: Traverse markers1→2→3 normally, test out-of-order/expiry, complete and Use console; repeat claim attempt.
events.expected: 12s sequence; successful run pays15 $DEB once/account; no teleport or movement buff required.

events.scenario: Observe three current clues; enter wrong order freely, replay and answer correctly; let answer window expire; inspect recipient-only UI.
events.expected: 15 $DEB once/account; wrong answers reset without cost; snapshots never reveal future sequence.

events.scenario: Start then stop during green; separately stop on red and test expiry; retry pending settlement without changing result.
events.expected: Green pays20 $DEB; red spends attempt and risks canonical Reckless; no paused combat or invulnerability.

events.scenario: Read displayed modifier/chance; Use once, compare logged face+STR against threshold, try repeat and reconnect.
events.expected: One stable ordinary d20+canonical STR vs12; success20 $DEB, failure no reward/cost; no reroll on retry.
events.result: Partially runtime observed/finite failed-attempt gate accepted on source16: face1+STR−1=0vs12, wallet0; ordinary repeated Use denied, same-dungeon regeneration retains exact spent receipt and replacement-machine Use denied. Explicit beyond-lock preview locator; ordinary route and success20 payout remain unaccepted.
pending: Ordinary event traversal/admission and combat-adjacent behavior

events.scenario: Start with missing Magic; cancel by movement/attack and explicit Use; then remain grounded, still and quiet until complete.
events.expected: Up to25 Magic after4s; full Magic/cancel spends no entitlement; once/account after success.

bosses.scenario: Observe one real Gordon, zero clones/turrets, his ordinary phases and actual defeat; collect key, open jail and rescue.
Black/Red/Gold bomb tells and cap; shoot bombs to defuse; destroy THE BIG ONE for backfire/stun; defeat and inspect death/key scene.
Committed bounce collision/landings; arcing melons and ricochets; marked produce rain keeps safe route; trap recovery and legitimate defeat.
Freeze Hero-specific mirrors; complete duplicate→Skeleton→Giant phases; bait pylon reflection; death/disconnect cannot reroll giant identity or add late mirrors.
Read basket preview and catalog; rolling/charge turns; reduce Shopping Spree props; bait cart corral recovery; bounded hazards and final key.
Poison soda patterns; interrupt or pre-jam exactly one vending attempt; observe finite visible healing stock, later buff and vending-return key.
Read Stable→Armed→Critical barrel states; bounded chains and self-damage; cover during internal detonation; safe gaps and finale key.
Charge/recline tells; temporary detached section retains primary boss authority; inverted punish window, safe furniture lanes and cleanup.
Readable sledge combo; safe traffic gaps; one-impact protection prevents pinball; bait designated car ricochet, validate pileup cover/routes.
Baseline run-to-button and E presses alone damage; weapons/Magic/statuses do not; TOO SLOW retries; distinguish fakes; Big Red then separate Jail Key button. Paired windows need real clients.
Steam/heat→overpressure vent→cooled vulnerability; optional relief valve changes vent safely; pipe patterns retain safe openings and standard Fire/status rules.
Alternate visible drill projectiles/return; bounded flank drones; bait drill-column rush and Overstrain recovery; no skating pinball.
Fill→Wash→Spin→Drain; wet/suds traction and optional drain clearing; Lost Sock fakeout and Rinse dry spaces; door weak point and cleanup.
Readable beaver face/tail and three distinct wood classes; defeat Jane first and Chuck first on separate runs; only Chuck HUD/receipt/key authority, all propane/wood retires.
Drawer cues, bounded existing-zombie batches and destructible PENDING markers; cancel markers by shooting/shredder; ceiling-bound surge; no boss healing.
Readable bounded Gunship routes, useful range/visibility; bombing and cover checks; optional beacons; permanent cover survives; designated crash/key.
Charge and connectivity-safe cone formations; finite CONED trap auto-releases solo; teammate release branch needs real clients; temporary lane closure and final ROAD OPEN.
BDD denies all ordinary damage; acquire/throw three unique Cleaners, miss/lose one to verify replacement; persistent0/3→3/3; no farming after break, then normal defeat.
Validate Strider body/knee/underbody routes; temporary knee stagger, fixed laser lock, permanent cover, no adds; controlled collapse and recoverable key.
One real Gordon+four fake clones+four owned Sentries; real death transfers to Hector without key; genuine Hector defeat yields final key; jail and Deborah rescue remain separate.

common_boss_gates: Inspect title/body/telegraph plus real attacks through all authored phases and unique counterplay. Do not kill special-completion bosses with console damage.
Ordinary boss defeat is not rescue: exactly one recoverable key, jail interaction and live Hero rescue are separate; Level20 requires Hector after Gordon.
Loss of all Hero lives retains uncleared boss phase/HP and mandatory-item progress; timer expiration owns automatic failure/reset. Fresh Hero entry must not reroll encounter.
Across high-risk modules: death/respawn, role/disconnect/rejoin, pause/reset and late join retire stale actors/projectiles/hazards/callbacks without losing required Cleaner/button/key progress.
All current stages obey protected entry, world cover/collision, finite shared actor/projectile/hazard limits, genuine attribution and deterministic identity.
Fixtures establish boss mechanics only. Ordinary start-to-finish campaign progression and three final varied clean passes remain required independently.
